scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src backend/src backend/test tests scripts *.json *.ts *.yaml .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src backend/src backend/test tests scripts *.json *.ts *.yaml .github
